# v0.3.32 — Each topic knows its project and where it stands

## What's changed

- **Each topic knows its project.** A topic now records the project (one of your DSH workspaces) it works in, worked out from the folder it works in; DSH's default workspace counts as no project. The topic directory shows it, and the classifier sees each topic's project by name, so "the invoice app" goes to a topic in that project rather than a similarly named one elsewhere. TheOne only reads your workspaces; it never creates or changes them.
- **Where a topic stands, kept apart from what it did.** Each topic keeps a record of the messages it worked on (its latest 20) and how each ended: done, failed, stopped, interrupted, or moved to the right topic after "wrong topic". Its status is worked out from that record: **Waiting on you** when it asks you something or a restart cut its work off, **Set aside** when it has been left longer than you usually come back, **Done** when you mark it so (a new message to it reopens it). The directory shows the status, with **Mark done** / **Reopen** beside **Manage**, and the classifier knows which topics are done or waiting.
- **After a restart, interrupted work is not redone on its own.** Work a topic was doing when DSH stopped is recorded as interrupted and never replayed, since it may already have changed something. If main chat still gets to a message whose work was cut off, it says so in plain words (and which topic had it) instead of showing an error, and "continue" carries on there. (DSH itself cancels messages still queued when it stops, as in an ordinary chat.)
- **Models that write their reasoning into the answer** (`<think>…</think>`, as some served through OpenAI-compatible APIs do, e.g. Nemotron or Qwen) no longer make routing fall back to rules: the reasoning is set aside before reading the decision. The eval client does the same.

TheOne only organises: it adds its own entries and views, and never changes your settings or your own chats.

Validation: automated tests (223) and type checks passed. In a fresh DSH with a test model that really runs commands: a reply cut off by a restart showed its topic as "Waiting on you"; topics working in a project folder showed that project; marking a topic done and reopening it worked from the directory.

## 中文

- **每个话题知道自己属于哪个项目。** 话题现在会记下它在哪个项目（你的某个 DSH 工作区）里干活，由它工作的文件夹推出来；DSH 的默认工作区算作没有项目。话题目录里会显示项目，路由模型也能看到每个话题的项目名，所以「发票那个应用」会去这个项目里的话题，而不是别处名字相近的话题。TheOne 只读取你的工作区，不新建也不修改。
- **话题的状态和它做过的事分开记。** 每个话题保留它处理过的消息记录（最近 20 条），以及每条怎么结束的：完成、失败、被停止、被中断，或「分错了」之后转给了正确的话题。状态由这份记录推出来：它在问你事情、或者重启打断了它的工作时是 **在等你**；比你通常回来的间隔还久没动是 **搁置**；你标为完成就是 **已完成**（再有消息发给它就自动重新打开）。话题目录会显示状态，**管理** 旁边有 **标为完成 / 重新打开**；路由模型也知道哪些话题已完成、哪些在等你。
- **重启后，被打断的工作不会自动重做。** DSH 停止时话题正在做的事会记为「中断」，不会自动重放，因为它可能已经改动了东西。如果主聊天之后仍轮到一条工作被打断的消息，会用普通的话说明情况（以及是哪个话题在处理），不再报错；说「继续」就在那里接着做。（DSH 停止时，自己会取消还在排队的消息，普通会话也一样。）
- **把思考过程写进回答里的模型**（`<think>…</think>`，部分通过 OpenAI 兼容接口提供的模型会这样，比如 Nemotron、Qwen）不再让路由退回规则：读取判断前会先跳过思考部分。评测脚本也一样。

TheOne 只做整理：它只添加自己的入口和视图，不改你的设置，也不改你自己的会话。

已通过自动化测试（223 项）和类型检查。在全新的 DSH 里用一个会真正执行命令的测试模型确认：被重启打断的回复，其话题显示为「在等你」；在项目文件夹里工作的话题显示了项目；在话题目录里标为完成、再重新打开都正常。
